purpose: Issue #52 identity truth contract. There is exactly ONE identity. It is not a character and it is not one of several personas: it is the real operator of this repository, described at a deliberately broad, privacy-preserving level. Nothing in acquisition/media-engine/ can create a second identity, and lib/identity.mjs refuses to load a file containing more than one.

default_disclosure_policy.note: Disclosure requirements are resolved per channel in channels.json. An unmet disclosure requirement blocks publication; it is never waived.

no_persona_expansion_rule: A successful desk or lens never becomes a new person. It may receive a dedicated publication name, a site section, an authorised channel or higher routing priority, and it stays transparently operated by the same person. No code in this repository creates an identity, a persona or an account.
